dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark brown exterior base coat to a lighter tan interior. The outer perimeters are defined by thin, high-intensity light-colored rings that are mostly elliptical and closed.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of small, irregular, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters is present in the anterior neck region and along the inferior lateral margin. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid points against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle in the mid-body region. A secondary geometric relationship is established by a linear sequence of four high-intensity blobs following the curvature of the posterior-lateral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal terminus of the lateral appendage features five distinct, high-intensity light-colored points arranged in a structured arc formation.
